## Introduction

`raquamaps` is a set of tools that make it easier to produce Aqua Maps -
model-based large-scale predictions of natural occurrences of marine
species. The default model uses estimates of environmental preferences
with respect to depth, water temperature, salinity, primary
productivity, and association with sea ice or coastal areas. These
estimates of species preferences, called environmental envelopes, are
derived from large sets of occurrence data available from online
collection databases.

It’s already possible to create Aqua Maps using <https://aquamaps.org>,
but the `raquamaps` package offers an open source alternative to the
earlier MS Access based solution, which simplifies licensing issues and
creates a solution which is easier to integrate, maintain and develop
further.

This package can be used in an IDE like `RStudio` (recommended) or from
an application like `QGIS` or the embedded UI can be used directly from
a web browser in order to generate predicted distribution maps for
marine species.

## Installing from github

If you want to install the latest version of the raquamaps package from
github, you can do it like so:

``` r
# First make sure you have the devtools package
# which simplifies installations from github
# Note: Windows users have to first install Rtools to use devtools

install.packages("devtools") 

# install the raquamaps package from github with this command
# which may require RCurl, if so you can first install RCurl with ...
# install.packages("RCurl")

library("devtools")
#install_github('raquamaps/raquamaps', build_vignettes=TRUE) 
install_git("https://github.com/raquamaps/raquamaps.git", build_vignettes=TRUE)
# ... or if you have RCurl:
install_github("raquamaps/raquamaps")  
```

## Quick start

Load the package in your R environment:

``` r
library("raquamaps")
```

To see some quick usage examples to get you started, open the Vignette.

[Click to see
Vignette](https://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps-intro.html)

## Building this package - for developers

Open the raquamaps directory’s .Rproj file in RStudio and use the Build
tab to build a source tarball (it will use the version number in the
DESCRIPTION file).

You may need to install a few libraries for the build to go through. R
libraries can be installed from within RStudio. Or you could do it at
the R prompt using commands like:

``` r
install.packages("RCurl")  
```

On some linux distros you may need system libraries, which can be
installed like so:

``` console
sudo apt-get install libgdal1-dev libproj-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev
```

Don’t forget to put the .tar.gz source tarball into the archive-tarball
directory before pushing changes to gitorious/github.

## References

- Kaschner, K., R. Watson, A.W. Trites and D. Pauly. 2006. Mapping
  worldwide distributions of marine mammals using a Relative
  Environmental Suitability (RES) model. Mar. Ecol. Prog. Ser.
  316:285-310.

- Ready, J., K. Kaschner, A.B. South, P.D. Eastwood, T. Rees, J.
  Rius, E. Agbayani, S. Kullander, and R. Froese. 2010. Predicting the
  distributions of marine organisms at the global scale. Ecol. Model.
  221: 467-478, <doi:10.1016/j.ecolmodel.2009.10.025>

- Kesner-Reyes, K., K. Kaschner, S. Kullander, C. Garilao, J. Barile,
  and R. Froese. 2012. AquaMaps: algorithm and data sources for aquatic
  organisms. In: Froese, R. and D. Pauly. Editors. 2012. FishBase. World
  Wide Web electronic publication. www.fishbase.org, version (04/2012).

- Östergren J, Kullander S O, Prud’homme O, Reyes K K, Kaschner K and
  Froese R (in preparation) Predicting freshwater-dependent species
  distributions in Europe

# Package index

## All functions

- [`adjust_spreads()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/adjust_spreads.md)
  : Adjustment of climate summary stat values during envelope parameter
  calculation
- [`aquamaps_galemys_pyrenaicus`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_galemys_pyrenaicus.md)
  : Example grid cell data for one specific species (Galemys
  pyrenaicus), approx 359 rows
- [`aquamaps_hc`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_hc.md)
  : Half degree cell metadata (only identifiers and coordinates)
- [`aquamaps_hcaf_eu`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_hcaf_eu.md)
  : Half degree cell authority file for EU with bioclimate data (8,493
  cells)
- [`aquamaps_hcaf_world`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_hcaf_world.md)
  : Half degree cell authority file for the world (259,200 cells) with
  bioclimate data
- [`aquamaps_presence_basins`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_presence_basins.md)
  : Example grid cell data for various species of a certain category
  with presence in a basin (approx 410 000 rows)
- [`aquamaps_presence_occurrences`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_presence_occurrences.md)
  : Example grid cell data for various species (approx 40 000 rows)
- [`aquamaps_qc`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquamaps_qc.md)
  : Quarter degree cell metadata (only identifiers and coordinates)
- [`aquatic_hcaf`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/aquatic_hcaf.md)
  : Half degree cell data (various bioclimate layers)
- [`calc_prob()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/calc_prob.md)
  : Function to calculate probability per individual bioclimate variable
  given "spread" summary stats for a single environment envelope
  parameter
- [`calc_probs()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/calc_probs.md)
  : Function to calculate probabilities
- [`calc_probs_by_species()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/calc_probs_by_species.md)
  : Retrieve environmental, determine spread and return probabilities
  for a given species, using the bundled reference data
- [`calc_spreads()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/calc_spreads.md)
  : Calculate environmental data spread summaries given environmental
  data for a species
- [`calc_spreads_by_species()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/calc_spreads_by_species.md)
  : Retrieve environmental data and determine spread for a given
  species, using the bundled reference data
- [`default_clim_vars()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/default_clim_vars.md)
  : Default bioclimate variable names in raquamaps
- [`default_hcaf()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/default_hcaf.md)
  : Default half degree cells reference data, including geometry and
  bioclimate measurements, for demonstrational purposes
- [`default_presence()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/default_presence.md)
  : Default presence data for several species, for demonstrational
  purposes
- [`default_species()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/default_species.md)
  : Default species in raquamaps
- [`default_species_list()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/default_species_list.md)
  : Default set of species for demonstrational purposes
- [`export_am_csv_tmp()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/export_am_csv_tmp.md)
  : Export results from as csv (tempfile)
- [`geocode_nominatim()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/geocode_nominatim.md)
  : Lookup coordinates using the Nominatim OSM API
- [`get_am_name_uris()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/get_am_name_uris.md)
  : Get aqua maps identifiers for a latin name
- [`get_dropbox_file()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/get_dropbox_file.md)
  : Download a dropbox folder content as a zip-file
- [`hcaf_by_species()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/hcaf_by_species.md)
  : Default half degree cells reference data, including geometry and
  bioclimate measurements, for demonstrational purposes, filtered for a
  specific species and for specific bioclimate measurements
- [`nativerange()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/nativerange.md)
  : Get native range dataset from aquamaps.org given latin name
- [`occs_ggmap_gridded()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/occs_ggmap_gridded.md)
  : Plots a raster layer as a gridded map using ggplot
- [`occs_ggmap_gridded_polys()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/occs_ggmap_gridded_polys.md)
  : Plots a raster grid using ggplot and polygons
- [`occs_ggmap_points()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/occs_ggmap_points.md)
  : Plots an occurrence data frame with points as a map using ggplot
- [`occs_webmap_gridded()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/occs_webmap_gridded.md)
  : Plots a raster grid using leaflet
- [`plot_stepped_raster()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/plot_stepped_raster.md)
  : Plot raster data in raquamaps style
- [`presence_rgbif()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/presence_rgbif.md)
  : Get presence data using rgbif
- [`r2df_points()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/r2df_points.md)
  : Converts a raster grid into a dataframe of points which can be
  plotted with ggplot
- [`r2df_polygons()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/r2df_polygons.md)
  : Converts a raster grid into a dataframe of closed polygons which can
  be plotted with ggplot
- [`rasterize_occs()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/rasterize_occs.md)
  : Converts points in data frame into raster
- [`rasterize_presence()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/rasterize_presence.md)
  : Converts presence data from rgbif into raster data
- [`rgbif_galemys_pyrenaicus`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/rgbif_galemys_pyrenaicus.md)
  : Example grid cell data for one specific species (Galemys pyrenaicus)
- [`rgbif_great_white_shark`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/rgbif_great_white_shark.md)
  : Example grid cell data for one specific species (Great White Shark)
- [`stepped_raster()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/stepped_raster.md)
  : Discretize a raster into intervals or steps for chloropeth maps
- [`which_cells()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/which_cells.md)
  : Return all grid cells identifiers where the specified species occurs
- [`which_cells_in_raster()`](http://raquamaps.github.io/raquamaps/reference/which_cells_in_raster.md)
  : Raster grid cell identifiers with presence
